_comment: Copy to config.json in your INSTALL folder (install.ps1 does this). Never put tokens or keys here: secrets live in user environment variables (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY).

messages._comment: Optional local inbox endpoint (POST, returns [{from,text,ts}]). Only http://127.0.0.1 / localhost URLs are accepted. secret_file (optional) is a file whose content is sent in the secret_header header; relative paths resolve against the install folder. When disabled the Messages tab is hidden.
